name: Miro
whatYouLose: Smooth real-time collaboration with dozens of cursors
Enterprise sharing controls and huge-board performance
prompt:
Build a collaborative whiteboard, a lightweight Miro alternative.

Stack: Vite + vanilla TS, tldraw SDK for the canvas, Yjs + y-websocket for real-time sync, Node server persisting docs to SQLite.
Features:
- Boards list with create/rename/delete; share link with edit or view-only tokens.
- Live cursors with names, presence avatars, sticky notes, shapes, arrows, text, images.
- Templates: retro (3 columns), kanban, 2x2 matrix, user journey.
- Export board to PNG and SVG; timer and voting dots for workshops.
Done when: two browsers on the same board see each other's cursors and sticky notes in real time.
notes: tldraw + Yjs make this surprisingly doable. Scale, templates and enterprise controls are what you lose.
